settings.playback.skip.prompt.detail: Show a reminder at the selected time when automatically skipping a segment.
settings.playback.skip.sources.footer: Drag to reorder; sources at the top have higher priority. Turning off a source disables all its segment markers. Rex contains manually saved data, Emby contains server chapters, and TheIntroDB / IntroDB / PublicMetaDB provide public timestamps.
settings.playback.video.metal.footer: If HDR playback flickers on iOS 17, enabling this forces Metal rendering as a workaround.
settings.playback.preference.startupAnim: Play the dinosaur animation while a video loads. When off, a loading indicator is shown.
settings.playback.cache.footer: A smaller cache may cause high-bitrate videos to be unplayable; please set according to your environment.
settings.playback.speed.longPressEnd.nor: Return to normal speed when released.
settings.playback.picture.rememberBright: Use the previously set screen brightness for the next playback.
settings.playback.cache.detailPreload.fo: After selecting a resource on the detail page, preload a small amount of data to accelerate playback. Requires server support.
settings.playback.kernel.app.detail: Uses the app’s built-in playback engine with AI audio transcription, more complete subtitle and danmu support, video enhancement, and playback controls. Recommended as the default.
settings.playback.picture.independentBri: Use separate brightness during playback. Restore the original screen brightness when returning to the Home Screen or ending playback.
settings.playback.skip.keepManual: Keep Skip Button After Cancelling Auto-Skip
settings.playback.speed.longPressEnd: Restore to when releasing long press
settings.playback.speed.longPressEnd.cur: Return to the speed used before the long press when released.
settings.playback.preference.alwaysFromS: Play from the beginning each time
settings.playback.picture.dv7To81.detail: When enabled, Dolby Vision Profile 7 metadata is converted to Profile 8.1 for better compatibility with some devices. Disable this option if you encounter issues.
settings.playback.gestures.verticalPan: Swipe Up/Down in Full Screen to Adjust Volume and Brightness
Supports hardware speed control, volume adjustment, and an equalizer for everyday playback.
settings.playback.sdrToHDR.footer: Only available on iPhone and iPad with HDR displays. SDR playback uses the legacy engine and consumes more power. HDR and Dolby Vision are not enhanced. Applies to the next playback. Video enhancement takes priority when both are enabled.
settings.playback.background.footer: After enabling automatic picture-in-picture in system settings, swiping up to return to the home screen will continue in picture-in-picture mode.
settings.playback.section.subtitle: Subtitles
mac.playback.sdrToHDR.footer: Available on HDR displays. Enhances highlights in SDR video; HDR and Dolby Vision are not enhanced. Applies to the next playback and consumes more power. Video enhancement takes priority when both are enabled.
settings.playback.upscale.footer: Quality enhancement uses AI to automatically upscale resolution and sharpness of anime at 1080P and below, which may affect other 1080P videos. You can manually disable this feature during playback.
settings.playback.title: Playback settings
settings.playback.gestures.locked: Allow long press and double tap operations when locked
settings.playback.kernel.v2.detail: Next-generation passthrough engine with native Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, and faster seeking. Automatically falls back to the app engine on failure.
settings.playback.audio.height.detail: Kernel 2.0 converts compatible audio while retaining height information. Requires compatible audio equipment. Uses lossy conversion, not bitstream passthrough, and may increase processing load. Applies the next time you open a video.
settings.playback.thumbnail.unavailable: Video preview requires the app engine. Switch playback engines first.
settings.playback.buttons.precisionWarni: Precise seek is off, so the current skip forward/backward accuracy may not be available.
settings.playback.audio.engine.hifi.deta: Prioritizes surround sound. Speed changes may require more processing time.
settings.playback.subtitle.footer: Normal subtitles use the App style by default, and ASS special effects subtitles retain the original effect by default. When turned on, the special effects subtitles will also use the App style.
settings.playback.dynamicHDR.footer: HDR dynamic mapping and the enhancement layer are processed frame by frame, which uses more power and can warm the device. Auto: plays the compatible picture when the device is hot, Low Power Mode is on, or the screen doesn't support HDR; if the device overheats or plays at a higher speed for a long time, the current episode switches smoothly to the compatible picture. Off: always plays the compatible picture.
settings.playback.kernel.v2.confirmation: This engine is experimental. Compressed streams pass directly to system rendering, supporting native Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos. Subtitles, seek previews, and AI audio transcription are available. Switch back to the app engine if problems occur.
settings.playback.kernel.experimental.co: This feature is still in beta. Some videos may have issues with subtitle selection or Dolby Atmos audio. Please disable this option if you encounter problems.
settings.playback.speed.longPressLock: Swipe Up to Lock While Fast Forwarding
settings.playback.preference.startSpec.d: Shows resolution, dynamic range, codec and audio in the top-left corner when playback starts
settings.playback.kernel.footer: Playback engines differ in startup speed, format compatibility, and subtitle support. Reopen the player after switching. ISO/BDMV disc sources automatically use the app engine to preserve disc structure and multi-version playback.
settings.playback.cache.smoothTransition: When the currently playing content buffers to the end, preload part of the next episode in advance to ensure a smooth transition.
settings.playback.audio.height.system: This experiment currently requires Kernel 2.0 on tvOS 26 or later.
settings.playback.kernel.experimental.de: Try this first only when Dolby Atmos is needed. AI audio transcription is not supported. On failure, playback falls back to the previously selected app or system engine.
settings.playback.kernel.system.detail: Uses the system AVPlayer engine for media that works better with system playback. AI audio transcription is not supported. The app engine is used as a fallback.
settings.playback.speed.longPressPan: Swipe Left/Right to Adjust Speed While Fast Forwarding
settings.playback.audio.height.v1: Kernel 1.0 does not support height audio output. This switch does not affect ordinary audio playback.
settings.playback.picture.autoLandscapeR: Automatically switch between landscape directions even when following device rotation is disabled.
settings.playback.seek.accurate.detail: Seek more accurately to the selected position. Seeking may take a little longer.
settings.playback.picture.dolbyBrightnes: Increase brightness for Dolby video. Turn this off if the picture is too bright or loses detail.
